title: SYSTEM-H NATQ-002 validation (n=40) — replacement preregistration, repaired FAIL clause

replaces.reason: Repair of the FAIL clause only. A decisive regression fell through to INCONCLUSIVE under EVAL-NATQ2-H-001 because FAIL tested only for an interval including zero.
replaces.authority: coordinator decision, 2026-09-05, accepting METRIC-AUDIT-001's proposed clause

system_under_test.name: SYSTEM-H-V2-DEV-CANDIDATE
system_under_test.identity_rule: The run is valid only if the runner's pinned H_CONFIG_HASH equals the value above. The locally minted hashes 026a302b… and 3fade96a… are NOT SYSTEM-H identities, must not be reproduced or force-matched, and must never be attached to the authoritative frozen system.

projection.proof: The rebuilt EXP-017 build record was diffed field by field against the recovered original: 31 of 34 fields identical, the only 3 differences being wall-clock timings. Every identity-determining field matches — projection_set_id, config hash, model id and fingerprint, n_versions 202, n_windows_considered 18060, n_projections 18057, n_skipped 3, n_covering_multi 12687, max_windows_in_one_doc 5158 and its version_id, embeddings 18057, fingerprint min=max, zero all-zero embeddings, tokens_seen 8125103, token_coverage 1.0.

bm25_comparator.status: IMMUTABLE — already scored, not to be rerun or tuned
bm25_comparator.role: frozen per-case pass/fail vector is the paired comparator input

metrics.definitions_inherit: METRIC-DEFS-V2 (EXP-024A), adapted to NATQ-002's own populations
metrics.span_hit: a gold span is HIT at depth k if any chunk returned in the top k overlaps the span's [char_start, char_end) interval in the span's own version_id

primary.name: micro-MRR
primary.definition: mean over ALL gold spans in the partition of 1/rank of the first returned chunk that hits that span; 0 if unhit within the evaluation depth

secondary.name: case_hit@10
secondary.definition: fraction of cases with at least one gold span hit in the top 10

secondary.name: case_full_coverage@10
secondary.definition: fraction of cases with EVERY gold span hit in the top 10

secondary.name: span_recall@10
secondary.definition: fraction of gold spans hit in the top 10

secondary.name: case_hit@1
secondary.definition: fraction of cases with at least one gold span hit at rank 1

secondary.name: per_slice_breakdown
secondary.definition: all of the above reported per authoring slice A-E, 8 cases each in validation

secondary.name: latency_p50_p95_ms
secondary.definition: end-to-end per-query wall time, reported but never used in the pass/fail decision

metrics.depth_is_fixed: Depth 10 is fixed now. Reporting a different depth after seeing results, or choosing the depth that looks best, invalidates the run.

multi_span_treatment.rule: Every gold span is an independent unit in micro-MRR and span_recall, so a 3-span case contributes three terms and weighs three times a 1-span case in the primary metric. Case-level metrics weigh every case equally regardless of span count. Both families are reported; neither substitutes for the other.
multi_span_treatment.full_coverage_rule: case_full_coverage@10 requires ALL of a case's gold spans hit. Partial coverage counts as a miss for that metric and as a partial hit for span_recall.
multi_span_treatment.no_reweighting: Multi-span cases are NOT downweighted to equalise case influence. Doing so after seeing results would be a metric change.

cross_provider_treatment.note: The single cross-provider case landed in RESERVE by the split's hash ordering, not by choice. It therefore does not affect the validation run at all, and this clause binds only a future reserve run.
cross_provider_treatment.rule: A02 is scored as an ordinary multi-span case. Its two gold spans live in different documents under different providers and each is hit or missed independently on its own version_id. No provider weighting is applied and no provider-specific metric is defined.
cross_provider_treatment.reporting: Because n=1, A02's outcome is reported as a named diagnostic and is never presented as a cross-provider rate.

decision_rule.primary_test: paired comparison of micro-MRR, SYSTEM-H minus BM25 baseline, over the 57 validation gold spans
decision_rule.statistic: paired bootstrap over CASES (not spans), 10,000 resamples, seed 20260904, reporting the mean delta and a 95% percentile interval
decision_rule.why_resample_cases: Spans within a case are not independent; resampling cases keeps the unit of independence honest.
decision_rule.PASS: micro-MRR delta > 0 with a 95% interval excluding 0, AND case_hit@10 >= 0.80
decision_rule.FAIL: the 95% interval includes 0, OR the 95% interval excludes 0 with a negative mean delta, OR case_hit@10 < 0.65
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: anything else — in particular an interval excluding 0 with a positive mean delta and case_hit@10 between 0.65 and 0.80

threshold_provenance.delta_test: Well grounded. It is a paired comparison against a baseline run on the same cases at the same time; no prior on NATQ-002 is needed.
threshold_provenance.case_hit_floors: WEAKLY GROUNDED AND FLAGGED. 0.80 and 0.65 are judgement calls, not derived from any NATQ-002 measurement, because none exists. They are set now so they cannot be set later. The coordinator should either approve them or replace them BEFORE the first run; changing them afterwards voids the preregistration.

thresholds_provenance.these_are_not_statistical_priors: They are engineering qualification floors. They are not estimates of expected performance and must not be described as statistical priors.

decision_rule.FAIL_change_rationale: Under the previous clause a SYSTEM-H result that was decisively WORSE than the BM25 control — interval excluding zero, negative mean delta — satisfied neither PASS nor FAIL whenever case_hit@10 was at or above 0.65, and was therefore labelled INCONCLUSIVE. That is the one direction a qualification rule must never soften. The added disjunct is the only substantive change in this document.
unchanged_from_EVAL_NATQ2_H_001: statistic and bootstrap procedure (paired, over cases, 10,000 resamples, seed 20260904)
primary_test (paired micro-MRR delta, SYSTEM-H minus BM25, over the 57 validation gold spans)

exhaustive_and_mutually_exclusive.residual_inconclusive_by_design: A significant improvement whose case_hit@10 lands in the 0.65-0.80 band. That band is the rule's purpose, not a gap.

disclosed_prior_evidence.statement: SYSTEM-H has been evaluated before. This is disclosed rather than implied absent.
disclosed_prior_evidence.definition_caveat: NOT definition-identical to NATQ-002 case_hit@10. METRIC-AUDIT-001 returned NOT_EQUIVALENT: strict_recall@10 requires ALL gold spans and additionally requires section_path equality, which case_hit@10 does not and NATQ-002 gold evidence cannot express. On identical retrieval strict_recall@10 <= case_hit@10, so 20/40 is a LOWER BOUND on what that run would have scored under case_hit@10, not an estimate of it. The two benchmarks also share no cases, so no paired reading exists between them. Prior evidence and historical anchor only.
disclosed_prior_evidence.implication_stated_plainly: The approved PASS floor of 0.80 sits well above this historical ~0.50 case-level result on a comparable natural-query set. On that evidence SYSTEM-H may well fail the floor. The floor is retained unchanged by coordinator ruling; this note exists so that outcome cannot later be presented as a surprise.
disclosed_prior_evidence.definition_caveat_previous_text: NOT asserted to be definition-identical to NATQ-002 case_hit@10. No metric-definition audit has been performed. Treated as prior evidence and a historical anchor, not as a directly comparable number.
disclosed_prior_evidence.caveat_update_note: The previous caveat said no metric-definition audit had been performed. One has been, and the earlier wording is preserved above. This is a factual correction to a disclosure, not a protocol change: no metric, threshold, population or procedure is altered by it.
comparison_prohibitions: Do not report a SYSTEM-H NATQ-002 result as a gain or loss against the historical 50%.
Do not present case_hit@10 as answer accuracy; it is retrieval evidence coverage.
Do not treat any NATQ-002 validation outcome as a release decision.

explicit_statements.do_not_read_this_as_SYSTEM_H_never_evalu: SYSTEM-H itself HAS been evaluated — on NATQ-001 validation. What has never been scored is NATQ-002.

permitted_runs.rule: Each scored validation run is logged with the system's score_determining_hash, a UTC timestamp and the resulting metrics. A configuration change produces a new hash and consumes one of the three runs. Exhausting three runs without a PASS ends the validation phase; it does not license a fourth.
permitted_runs.reserve_run_precondition: a PASS on validation, plus an explicit owner decision, plus an access-log entry written before the read

reserve_prohibition.during_tuning: evals/splits/natq-002/reserve.json may not be opened, read, summarised, sampled, or used to inform any configuration, prompt, threshold or architecture decision while tuning is in progress.
reserve_prohibition.log_before_read: The access-log entry is appended BEFORE the file is opened, so an unlogged read is detectable as a hash change with no preceding entry.

allowed_after_validation_before_reserve: Change SYSTEM-H configuration, which mints a new score_determining_hash and consumes a validation run.
Re-run validation up to the three-run cap.
Analyse validation failures case by case, including reading validation gold evidence.
Declare the validation phase finished and stop.
Propose a new experiment against a different benchmark or partition.
prohibited_after_validation_before_reser: Opening or sampling the reserve partition for any reason short of the documented unlock.
Changing NATQ-002 membership, question text, or gold spans.
Changing any metric definition, the evaluation depth, or the decision thresholds.
Moving a case between validation and reserve.
Re-running the split with a different salt or method.
Reporting a metric not listed above as though it were preregistered.

shared_scorer_requirement.rule: SYSTEM-H and the frozen BM25 comparator MUST be scored by one shared scorer implementing the NATQ-002 definitions: version_id plus character overlap, ANY-span aggregation for case_hit@10, fixed depth 10, per-case denominator for case metrics, per-span denominator for span metrics and micro-MRR with unhit spans contributing 0.
shared_scorer_requirement.prohibited: NATQ-001 section_path-dependent matching (overlaps/dict_overlaps from EXP-018) must not be used to score NATQ-002. It is also uncomputable here: NATQ-002 gold evidence carries no section_path field.
shared_scorer_requirement.precondition_before_SYSTEM_H_is_scored: The shared scorer must reproduce the frozen comparator from its stored ranked output, offline, with no BM25 retrieval rerun: case_hit@10 = 0.375 and micro-MRR = 0.1425 at the recorded precision, plus an exact match of the stored per-case pass/fail vector.
shared_scorer_requirement.on_disagreement: STOP and report. Do not regenerate comparator retrieval.
